cases.name: done line
cases.code: S=ss([0 1;-2 -3],eye(2),eye(2),zeros(2)); sz=size(S); [ny,nu,nd,n4]=size(S); o=order(S); Q=S(2,1); one=issiso(Q); many=issiso(S); [n,d]=tfdata(Q,'v');

cases.name: ss tf and zpk conversions
cases.code: S=ss([0 1;-2 -3],[1 2 3;4 5 6],[1 3;2 4],[2 0 4;6 3 8]); F=tf(S); G=ss(F); H=zpk(S); J=ss(H); K=tf(H); L=zpk(F); F0=evalfr(F,(0.5)); F1=evalfr(F,(2i)); F2=evalfr(F,((2-1i))); G0=evalfr(G,(0.5)); G1=evalfr(G,(2i)); G2=evalfr(G,((2-1i))); H0=evalfr(H,(0.5)); H1=evalfr(H,(2i)); H2=evalfr(H,((2-1i))); J0=evalfr(J,(0.5)); J1=evalfr(J,(2i)); J2=evalfr(J,((2-1i))); K0=evalfr(K,(0.5)); K1=evalfr(K,(2i)); K2=evalfr(K,((2-1i))); L0=evalfr(L,(0.5)); L1=evalfr(L,(2i)); L2=evalfr(L,((2-1i)));

cases.name: tf zpk and ss round trips
cases.code: F=tf({1,[2 3];4,0},{[1 1],[1 4 5];[2 6],1},0.1); G=ss(F); H=zpk(F); J=tf(H); K=ss(H); F0=evalfr(F,(0.5)); F1=evalfr(F,(2i)); F2=evalfr(F,((2-1i))); G0=evalfr(G,(0.5)); G1=evalfr(G,(2i)); G2=evalfr(G,((2-1i))); H0=evalfr(H,(0.5)); H1=evalfr(H,(2i)); H2=evalfr(H,((2-1i))); J0=evalfr(J,(0.5)); J1=evalfr(J,(2i)); J2=evalfr(J,((2-1i))); K0=evalfr(K,(0.5)); K1=evalfr(K,(2i)); K2=evalfr(K,((2-1i)));

response_cases.name: full arithmetic and numeric gains
response_cases.code: G=ss(-1,[1 2],[2;3],[1 -.5;.1 .7]);H=ss(-2,[-2 1],[1;-1],[.2 .4;-.3 .5]);R=series(G,H); S=H*G; P=parallel(G,H); M=G-H; F=feedback(G,H,+1); A=[1 2]*G; B=G*[1;2]; C=2*G; D=-G; rfreq=freqresp(R,[.2 1.5 4]); sfreq=freqresp(S,[.2 1.5 4]); pfreq=freqresp(P,[.2 1.5 4]); mfreq=freqresp(M,[.2 1.5 4]); ffreq=freqresp(F,[.2 1.5 4]); afreq=freqresp(A,[.2 1.5 4]); bfreq=freqresp(B,[.2 1.5 4]); cfreq=freqresp(C,[.2 1.5 4]); dfreq=freqresp(D,[.2 1.5 4]);

response_cases.name: concatenation and class precedence
response_cases.code: G=ss(-1,[1 2],[2;3],[1 -.5;.1 .7]);H=ss(-2,[-2 1],[1;-1],[.2 .4;-.3 .5]);A=append(G,tf(H),zpk(2,3,4)); B=[tf(G) zpk(H)]; C=[G;tf(H)]; R=series(tf(G),zpk(H)); P=tf(G)-tf(H); F=feedback(zpk(G),tf(H)); afreq=freqresp(A,[.2 1.5 4]); bfreq=freqresp(B,[.2 1.5 4]); cfreq=freqresp(C,[.2 1.5 4]); rfreq=freqresp(R,[.2 1.5 4]); pfreq=freqresp(P,[.2 1.5 4]); ffreq=freqresp(F,[.2 1.5 4]);
